title: Annual benefits review notice

left.subject: Benefits update — action required
left.bodyHtml:
Hi Lina,

Your health benefits profile shows missing information.

To avoid coverage suspension, log in and complete your details using the link below.

right.subject: Annual benefits review notice
right.bodyHtml:
Hi Lina,

Our annual benefits review opens next month.

You can access your benefits details via the HR Portal on the intranet.

We will not request sensitive updates by email.

explainPoints: External wellness-domain: Email A uses "wellness-nexatrust.com" which is not an official HR domain. Email B uses the real "nexatrust.com" domain.
Fear-based wording: Email A threatens "coverage suspension" which is not used by HR. Email B provides normal informational notice about annual review.
Requesting sensitive updates: Email A asks to "complete details" via email link, violating HR security policy. Email B states "We will not request sensitive updates by email."
